formats.national: X XXX XXX (7-digit) / X XXXX XXXX (9-digit)

examples.note: Lilongwe — Malawi Telecom geographic numbers on the 1 prefix are 7 digits
Mobile — 9 is an Airtel Malawi range; mobile NSNs are 9 digits

notes: Malawi has no area codes; the leading digit identifies the operator and service.
Legacy 7-digit geographic numbers on the 1 prefix coexist with 9-digit numbers introduced after the 2009 plan revision, so length varies.
sources: MACRA — Malawi Communications Regulatory Authority: https://www.macra.mw/
